context_quotes: These characteristics make them suitable for direct use in thermoelectric generators (TEGs) as the charge carriers can be effectively transported from one electrode to the other via the external circuit.

record.subject: Ionic-electronic interactions between sodium ions and CNT-COOH carboxyl groups
record.quote: The presence of CNT-COOH facilitates the ionic conductivity and enhances the ionic Seebeck coefficient via ionic-electronic interactions between sodium ions and carboxyl groups on CNT-COOH, which can be observed in X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy results, thereby promoting the charge transport properties.

record.subject: Optimum hydrogel device
record.object: Ionic power factor of 6.06 mW m-1 K-2
record.quote: As a result, the optimum device exhibits a remarkable ionic conductivity of 175.3 mS cm(-1) and a high ionic Seebeck coefficient of 18.6 mV K-1, giving an ionic power factor (PF i ) of 6.06 mW m(-1) K-2 with a correspondingly impressive ionic figure of merit (ZT i ) of 2.65.
